properties.name: openapi.production-url
properties.description: Public address of the API, listed as the first server of the OpenAPI document.

properties.name: admin.default.email
properties.description: Admin default email

properties.name: admin.default.password
properties.description: Admin default password

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: List of origins allowed to access the API (e.g., http://localhost:3000).

properties.name: cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: List of HTTP methods allowed for CORS requests (e.g., GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS).

properties.name: cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: List of HTTP headers allowed in CORS requests (e.g., Authorization, Content-Type).

properties.name: cors.test-origin
properties.description: Single origin URL used for testing CORS configuration. Only used in test environment.

properties.name: rate-limit.window-minutes
properties.description: Time window in minutes for rate-limiting.

properties.name: rate-limit.unauthenticated.capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of anonymous requests allowed in a burst, per client IP address. Login attempts have their own limit.

properties.name: rate-limit.unauthenticated.refill
properties.description: Number of tokens refilled per window for anonymous requests, per client IP address.

properties.name: rate-limit.user.capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per window for authenticated users.

properties.name: rate-limit.user.refill
properties.description: Number of tokens refilled per window for authenticated users.

properties.name: rate-limit.admin.capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per window for admin users.

properties.name: rate-limit.admin.refill
properties.description: Number of tokens refilled per window for admin users.

properties.name: rate-limit.login.capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of login attempts allowed in a burst, per client IP address.

properties.name: rate-limit.login.refill
properties.description: Number of tokens refilled per window for login attempts, per client IP address.

properties.name: jwt.issuer
properties.description: The issuer to be included in the JWT token's claims.

properties.name: jwt.audience
properties.description: The audience to be included in the JWT token's claims and required on incoming tokens.

properties.name: jwt.access-expiration-ms
properties.description: The expiration time (in milliseconds) for the access token.

properties.name: jwt.refresh-expiration-ms
properties.description: The expiration time (in milliseconds) for the refresh token.

properties.name: oauth2.key-rotation.enabled
properties.description: Indicates if the key rotation is enabled.

properties.name: oauth2.key-rotation.cron
properties.description: A cron job to schedule the key rotations.

properties.name: redis.embedded
properties.description: Use embedded Redis for tests

values.description: Allow OPTIONS requests (required for CORS preflight)
